seo.title: About | Xiangyin Gu – Artist & Researcher — Xiangyin Gu
seo.titleZh: 关于 | Xiangyin Gu – 艺术家与研究者 — Xiangyin Gu
seo.description: Learn about Xiangyin Gu, a London-based artist and PhD researcher specializing in interdisciplinary photography, memory studies, and psychoanalytic art. Explore past and current exhibitions, ongoing projects, and research that connects personal archives with broader cultural and historical contexts.
seo.descriptionZh: 了解 Xiangyin Gu——一位常驻伦敦的艺术家与博士研究者，专注于跨学科摄影、记忆研究与精神分析艺术。浏览其过往与当前的展览、进行中的项目，以及将个人档案与更广阔的文化和历史语境相连接的研究。

blocks.html: Xiangyin Gu, born and raised in Suzhou (China), is an artist based in London (United Kingdom). He is currently a PhD candidate at Royal College of Art, London. His interdisciplinary practice bridges writing and photography, with a particular focus on psychoanalytic explorations of memory, trauma, and intergenerational transmission. His work investigates the psychical spaces where temporality and history intersect, challenging conventional modes of representation. Gu’s long-term projects, Entangled Pasts and Eternal Return, explores alternative narratives of family history and collective memory.
blocks.htmlZh: Xiangyin Gu 生长于中国苏州，现为常驻英国伦敦的艺术家，目前是伦敦英国皇家艺术学院的博士候选人。他的跨学科实践连接写作与摄影，尤其关注以精神分析的方式探索记忆、创伤与代际传递。他的作品探究时间性与历史相交汇的心理空间，挑战传统的再现方式。他的长期项目《纠缠的过往》与《永恒轮回》探索家族史与集体记忆的另类叙事。
